# Final Grade Calculator

> Free student calculator for answering: what score do I need on my final exam?

## Primary pages
- https://finalgradecalculator.app/ — Final Grade Calculator with live required-score result, formula, examples, copy/share actions, and structured FAQ.
- https://finalgradecalculator.app/weighted-grade-calculator/ — Weighted category calculator for assignments, quizzes, labs, projects, and final exams.
- https://finalgradecalculator.app/what-grade-do-i-need/ — Exact-intent guide for the "what grade do I need on my final" query.
- https://finalgradecalculator.app/how-to-calculate-final-grade/ — Step-by-step final grade formula guide.
- https://finalgradecalculator.app/grade-converter/ — Percentage, letter grade, and GPA converter.
- https://finalgradecalculator.app/calculators/ — Index of all grade calculators and guides.
